title: Barbed Versus Conventional Sutures for Vaginal Cuff Closure During Total Laparoscopic Hysterectomy
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to estimate whether the use of the barbed suture facilitates laparoscopic suturing of the vaginal cuff during total laparoscopic hysterectomy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with an indication for hysterectomy ( i.e. pain, bleeding and pressure symptoms)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Genital malignancy
* Uterine size more than 16 weeks
* Coagulation defects or concurrent anticoagulant therapy
* Pregnancy
* Compromised cardiopulmonary status
* Contraindications for general anesthesia
